name: content-market
description: Reconstructs a marketplace ContentListingV1 PURELY from on-chain mint calldata (contentId == bytes16 KID, tokenURI, opType, sell terms); holds no chain RPC, no IPFS, no keys
author: elastos

authority.reason: Decodes a content-mint's calldata back into a typed listing so the consumer can discover what a producer published. Reconstruction is pure: it reads only the calldata bytes, mints nothing, holds no keys, and fails closed on a foreign/malformed call. Human-facing enrichment (metadata.json title/poster/mime, live log scan) is delegated to ipfs-provider + chain-provider.

interfaces.description: Runtime provider affordance descriptors projected from content-market authority metadata; descriptors are not grants.

methods.description: Request status through the content-market Runtime provider boundary for elastos://market/*.
Request reconstruct listing through the content-market Runtime provider boundary for elastos://market/*.
